problems.stem: The Module 2 Branding Studio asks you to submit a complete brand package. Which set of artifacts belongs in that package?
options: A single polished resume PDF and nothing else.
A resume, a professional bio, an aligned LinkedIn headline and About section, a portfolio link, and an AI-use log.
Only screenshots of your LinkedIn profile.
A folder of unrelated class assignments.
problems.explanation: The studio integrates the whole module: resume, bio, LinkedIn, portfolio, and the AI-use log that shows your judgment across them. One isolated file is not a package.

problems.stem: When you do the final consistency pass on your brand package, which mismatch is most important to fix?
options: Your resume uses Arial but your bio uses Calibri.
Your resume lists "May 2026 graduation" but your LinkedIn says "Dec 2025," so the two contradict each other.
Your portfolio uses a blue accent and your resume uses black.
Your bio is one sentence longer than your LinkedIn About.
problems.explanation: Contradictory facts (two different graduation dates) break trust the moment a recruiter cross-checks. Font and color differences are cosmetic by comparison.

problems.stem: For the studio's AI-use log, which entry best demonstrates the bounded, accountable use this module teaches?
options: "AI wrote my whole package; I just submitted it."
"I did not use AI at all, so there is nothing to report." (but you did use it)
"I used AI to brainstorm 5 headline options, chose 1 that matched my real focus, rejected 2 that overstated my experience, and rewrote the rest in my own words."
"AI is unreliable so I ignored every suggestion."
problems.explanation: Accountable use means the tool helped within a bounded task while you made and recorded the judgments: what you chose, what you rejected, and why. The log shows your voice on top of the tool's help.

problems.stem: What is the strongest sign that your Module 2 package is ready to submit?
options: Every document is visually polished and free of typos.
A reader can open any two artifacts and find the same name, title, dates, and headline accomplishment, and your AI-use log explains any place a tool helped.
It is the longest package you have ever made.
An AI tool rated it a 10 out of 10.
problems.explanation: Readiness in this studio is consistency plus accountability: the artifacts agree on the facts, and the AI-use log makes your judgment visible. Polish and length alone do not prove either.
